rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for an individual building brick.

example.english: This brick fell onto the ground.
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 zyun1 tau4 dit3 zo2 lok6 dei6

rows.note: Use this for brick as a building material, or more generally when the individual-versus-material distinction is not important.

example.english: This wall is made of brick.
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 coeng4 jung6 zyun1 cai3 sing4 gaa3
